mapper.insert: insert into orders(order_no, user_id, address_id, total_amount, status, payment_status, logistics_status, refund_status, coupon_id, discount_amount, payment_method, created_at) values(#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{addressId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, 'UNPAID', '待支付', 'NONE', #{couponId}, #{discountAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select id from orders where order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert: insert into order_item(order_id, product_id, product_name, spec_text, unit_price, quantity, subtotal) values(#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{specText}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{subtotal})
mapper.select: select * from orders order by created_at desc, id desc
mapper.update: update orders set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update orders set payment_status = #{paymentStatus} where id = #{id}
update orders set logistics_status = #{logisticsStatus} where id = #{id}
update orders set refund_status = #{refundStatus} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from order_logistics where order_id=#{orderId} order by created_at asc,id asc
